project_type: Single-page PWA app with vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript
build_system: None - static files served directly, no bundler
build_command: N/A - static site, validate by opening index.html
verification_instructions: Open index.html in browser; verify new pages render without JS errors; check navigation works between all pages
setup_instructions: No setup needed - plain static files
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. No build tools needed. This is a client-side-only app.
contribution_requirements: Keep same design language (Islamic green theme, card-based, mobile-first). Use Font Awesome 6.5 icons. Use Google Fonts Poppins + Amiri. Use localStorage for persistence.

key_patterns.routing: Hash-based routing in App.handleRoute() - switch on window.location.hash
key_patterns.page_structure: Each page is a <section id='xxx-page' class='page'> in index.html
key_patterns.page_activation: pages object maps name to DOM element; showPage() hides all, shows target
key_patterns.module_pattern: IIFE modules (App, API, Storage) returning public methods
key_patterns.data_flow: API module fetches from equran.id, returns parsed JSON data
key_patterns.styling: CSS variables for theming, dark mode via [data-theme='dark'], mobile-first max-width 480px
key_patterns.nav: Bottom nav with .nav-item buttons, data-page attribute for routing

directory_structure: Flat structure: index.html at root, css/style.css, js/app.js + api.js + storage.js, assets/ for icons, sw.js for service worker
